name: ops/execution-permit-consume-result-valid
description: The §13.1 ExecutionConsumptionReceipt as execution_permit_consume returns it, with EVERY member the frozen shape defines rendered — no digest member is ever null, which is what a consumer needs to verify the binding it must hold before egress (kovee seam finding, gap note G48). The class of each digest is the one the consumer can check, per member (A8, PROFILE.md §6.2, R3-L01): intent_digest, subject_digest and episode_fence_digest are byom's OWN committed record digests — local_erasure_safe, recomputed by byom rather than echoed by the consumer, and no longer request members at all; disclosure_digest is the HOST's own manifest digest, portable_public, and the value rendered is the one the act was AUTHORIZED for, not the one the consumption carried (R3-A01); mandate_use_digest and digest are portable_public over the frozen bpp-mandate-use-binding-v0 and bpp-execution-consumption-receipt-binding-v0 fragments, and both values here are the real re-derived digests over exactly those fragments — the b3_act_chain suite recomputes them from this vector.
